title: About Me & Introductions
description: Constructing personal profile sentences: origins, academic major, and personal aspirations.

items.explanation: 'aus' is used to indicate origin or country of departure.
'Informatik' is the German term for Computer Science.
Standard formal or neutral phrase to introduce your name.
'möchte' is the polite modal verb meaning 'would like to'.
options: I would like to study in Germany.
items.correctAnswer: I would like to study in Germany.

items.prompt: Ich lerne Deutsch seit drei Monaten.
items.soundText: Ich lerne Deutsch seit drei Monaten.
items.explanation: 'seit' with dative expresses an action that started in the past and continues ('since' / 'for').
options: I have been learning German for three months.
I will learn German in three months.
German is difficult for three months.
I lived in Germany three months ago.
items.correctAnswer: I have been learning German for three months.
